question: Get orders with customer names

question: Get employees with office city

question: Get payments with customer names
sql_query: SELECT c.customerName, p.amount, p.paymentDate FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;

question: Get order details with product names
sql_query: SELECT od.orderNumber, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered, od.priceEach FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

question: Get products with product line description
sql_query: SELECT p.productName, pl.textDescription FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

question: Get customers with sales rep names
sql_query: SELECT c.customerName, e.firstName, e.lastName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber;

question: Get orders with customer city

question: Get employees and their manager
sql_query: SELECT e.firstName AS employee_first, e.lastName AS employee_last, m.firstName AS manager_first, m.lastName AS manager_last FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber;

question: Get orderdetails with product vendor

question: Get payments with customer country
sql_query: SELECT c.customerName, c.country, p.amount FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;

question: Count customers per country
sql_query: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

question: Total payments per customer
sql_query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payments FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY total_payments DESC;

question: Number of orders per status

question: Products per product line

question: Employees per office
sql_query: SELECT o.city, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employee_count FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.city;

question: Total stock per product vendor

question: Average buy price per product line

question: Orders per customer
